articles.summary: Traeger, Inc. (“Traeger” or the “Company”) (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced that it will release its first quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Monday, May 11, 2026. Management will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results.
